title: Following how a storm develops
description: The chosen place, the changes to the forecast and the warnings available, gathered together.

blocks.text: A general map with a track line does not explain which time the latest update refers to.

quote.text: During hurricane Milton I used this app to keep a close tracking of the landfall trajectory and decide when and where to evacuate. Very helpful and easy to use.

blocks.text: Show the issue time, the forecast area and its changes, and keep a way through to the official messages. Allow several addresses to be followed.
A forecast contains uncertainty. A single thin line should not create the appearance of an exact future path.
